info.description: Manual API requests with editable examples and no variables or scripts. Replace each example ID of 0 with a real ID from a create response or a list result. Match owner IDs in the URL, Params, and Body where required. Use unique emails, driver license numbers, and vehicle plates for repeated creates. Cleanup is optional and deletes the records whose IDs you enter. Use Validation Scenarios for the numbered checks from the project brief.

item.name: Validation Scenarios
item.description: Manual acceptance checks for the 11 numbered scenarios on page 5 of the project brief. Run against a development database. Prepare two drivers, one vehicle for each driver (Hamid’s vehicle must have capacity 4), and three passengers: Salma, Karim, and Imane. Use the standard resource folders to create or look up these records. Replace each example ID of 0 with the appropriate real ID in the URL, Params, or Body. Record the IDs returned by create requests. Compare responses manually; the collection uses no variables or scripts.

item.name: Baseline Trip and Booking Workflow
item.description: Run in order on the same trip. In cases 01 and 03, check the amount in the POST response and the remaining seats and status in the trip detail. If you change the example trip date, edit the search date to match.

request.description: Use Hamid’s driver ID and his four-seat vehicle ID. Offer three seats. Set departure at least three days ahead in the server’s local time. Expect 201; record the trip ID.

item.name: 01 — Book One Seat on a Segment

request.description: Use Salma’s passenger ID and the baseline trip ID. Expect 201, totalAmount 50.00 DH and status CONFIRMED.
Use the baseline trip ID. Expect 200, remainingSeats 2 and status PUBLISHED.
Expect 200. Hamid’s baseline trip ID must not appear in the results. Other trips may match.
Use Karim’s passenger ID and the baseline trip ID. Expect 201 and totalAmount 160.00 DH. Record Karim’s reservation ID.
Use the baseline trip ID. Expect 200, remainingSeats 0 and status FULL.

item.name: 04 — Reject Booking on a Full Trip

request.description: Use Imane’s passenger ID and the baseline trip ID while it is FULL. Brief expectation: 409. The current backend may return 400 (TRIP_NOT_PUBLISHED); that is a mismatch, not a pass.

item.name: 05 — Cancel a Booking Before the Deadline

query.description: ID of the passenger who owns this record.

request.description: Use Karim’s reservation ID in the URL and his passenger ID in Params. Run at least 24 hours before the baseline trip departs (the brief’s example uses three days). Expect 204.
Use the baseline trip ID. Expect 200, remainingSeats 2 and status PUBLISHED.
Use Imane’s passenger ID and the reopened baseline trip ID. Expect 400 (REVERSED_STOPS).

item.name: Publication and Trip Lifecycle Rules
item.description: Use valid IDs and change only the condition under test. For time-sensitive checks, use the server’s local time.

request.description: Use Hamid’s ID and his own vehicle with capacity 4. This request offers 5 seats. Expect 400. Keep departure in the future.
Use Hamid’s driver ID and a vehicle ID owned by a different driver. Keep the departure in the future and use a vehicle with capacity of at least 3. Expect 403.

query.description: ID of the driver who owns this record.

request.description: Use Hamid’s driver ID and the ID of a published trip departing later today (create a separate future trip, or use the baseline trip while it is still ahead). Brief expectation: 409. The current backend returns 400 (TRIP_NOT_DEPARTED); that is a mismatch, not a pass.

item.name: Cancellation Rules
item.description: Use two separate trips for cases 10 and 11. Do not reuse the baseline trip or the IDs from its reservations.

item.name: 10 — Setup: Publish a Trip Departing in Two Hours

request.description: Use Hamid’s driver and vehicle IDs. Replace every example stop timestamp: choose first departure about two hours from the current server time and keep the following stops strictly later. Expect 201.

item.name: 10 — Setup: Create the Booking to Cancel

request.description: Use Salma’s ID and the trip ID from case 10. Expect 201; record the reservation ID.

query.description: ID of the passenger who owns this record.

request.description: Use the reservation ID from case 10 and Salma’s passenger ID. Make sure the trip still departs in about two hours. Expect 409 (CANCELLATION_TOO_LATE).
Use Hamid’s IDs. Choose a future departure different from the baseline trip; set all the stop timestamps accordingly. Expect 201.
Use Salma’s ID and the separate trip ID from case 11. Expect 201 and CONFIRMED; record this reservation ID.
Use Karim’s ID and the same case 11 trip ID. Expect 201 and CONFIRMED; record this reservation ID.

item.name: 11 — Cancel a Trip With Confirmed Bookings

query.description: ID of the driver who owns this record.

request.description: Use the case 11 trip ID and Hamid’s driver ID. Expect 204. Verify all three state changes using the next requests.
Use the case 11 trip ID. Expect 200 and status CANCELLED.

item.name: Search Filters and Pagination
item.description: Run while the baseline trip is PUBLISHED and has seats available. Match dates to the fixtures you created. The known PostgreSQL search error is a backend issue if it occurs.

item.name: Find a Segment on the Departure Date

request.description: Expect 200; the baseline trip should appear with segmentPrice 30.00 DH.

item.name: Exclude a Trip on a Different Date

request.description: Set the date one day after your baseline trip. Expect 200 and no baseline trip in the results.

item.name: Include a Segment at the Price Limit

request.description: Expect 200 and the baseline trip at 30.00 DH per seat. The full-trip price of 120.00 DH should not affect this match.

item.name: Exclude a Segment Above the Price Limit

request.description: Expect 200 and no baseline trip in the results; the segment costs 30.00 DH.

item.name: Setup — Publish a Second Search Result

request.description: Use valid ownership IDs and the same date and route as the baseline trip, but later passing times. Expect 201. Keep both trips PUBLISHED with seats available.

item.name: Read the First Page in Departure Order

request.description: Expect 200 and at most one result. With only the two matching fixtures, expect the earlier trip’s ID.

item.name: Read the Next Page in Departure Order

request.description: Expect 200 and at most one result. With only the two matching fixtures, expect the later trip’s ID, distinct from the first page.
